package domain

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

const (
	PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPrivate int16 = iota
	PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityUnlisted
	PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPublic
)

const (
	PracticeTaskPublicationStatusPending int16 = iota
	PracticeTaskPublicationStatusReady
)

type StudentPracticeTaskPublication struct {
	ID                    string          `json:"id"`
	StudentPracticeTaskID string          `json:"-"`
	StudentID             string          `json:"-"`
	ShareSlug             string          `json:"share_slug"`
	Visibility            int16           `json:"-"`
	Status                int16           `json:"-"`
	SnapshotStorageFileID string          `json:"-"`
	SnapshotSHA256        string          `json:"-"`
	SnapshotManifestJSON  json.RawMessage `json:"-"`
	SecurityReportJSON    json.RawMessage `json:"-"`
	TaskSnapshotJSON      json.RawMessage `json:"-"`
	ResultSnapshotJSON    json.RawMessage `json:"-"`
	PublishedAt           *time.Time      `json:"published_at,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt             time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt             time.Time       `json:"updated_at"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationFile struct {
	Path   string `json:"path"`
	Size   int    `json:"size"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationManifest struct {
	Version            int                           `json:"version"`
	Files              []PracticeTaskPublicationFile `json:"files"`
	TotalBytes         int                           `json:"total_bytes"`
	ExcludedFilesCount int                           `json:"excluded_files_count"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationSecurityReport struct {
	Version       int      `json:"version"`
	ExcludedPaths []string `json:"excluded_paths"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationMilestoneSnapshot struct {
	Title       string   `json:"title"`
	Description *string  `json:"description,omitempty"`
	StackCodes  []string `json:"stack_codes"`
	SortOrder   int      `json:"sort_order"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot struct {
	PracticeTaskID string                                     `json:"practice_task_id"`
	RevisionNumber int                                        `json:"revision_number"`
	Title          string                                     `json:"title"`
	Theme          string                                     `json:"theme"`
	VariantCode    string                                     `json:"variant_code"`
	VariantTitle   string                                     `json:"variant_title"`
	Topology       string                                     `json:"topology"`
	StackCodes     []string                                   `json:"stack_codes"`
	Milestones     []PracticeTaskPublicationMilestoneSnapshot `json:"milestones"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationResultSnapshot struct {
	Passed      bool       `json:"passed"`
	MentorScore *float64   `json:"mentor_score,omitempty"`
	CompletedAt *time.Time `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
	ReviewedAt  *time.Time `json:"reviewed_at,omitempty"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationView struct {
	ID             string                                 `json:"id,omitempty"`
	ShareSlug      string                                 `json:"share_slug"`
	Visibility     string                                 `json:"visibility"`
	PublishedAt    *time.Time                             `json:"published_at,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time                              `json:"created_at"`
	Task           PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot    `json:"task"`
	Result         PracticeTaskPublicationResultSnapshot  `json:"result"`
	Manifest       PracticeTaskPublicationManifest        `json:"manifest"`
	SecurityReport *PracticeTaskPublicationSecurityReport `json:"security_report,omitempty"`
	Files          []WorkspaceFile                        `json:"files,omitempty"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationSummary struct {
	ShareSlug   string                                `json:"share_slug"`
	PublishedAt *time.Time                            `json:"published_at,omitempty"`
	Task        PracticeTaskPublicationTaskSnapshot   `json:"task"`
	Result      PracticeTaskPublicationResultSnapshot `json:"result"`
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationRepository interface {
	CreatePendingPublication(ctx context.Context, publication StudentPracticeTaskPublication) error
	GetPublicationByProjectID(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*StudentPracticeTaskPublication, error)
	GetPublicationBySlug(ctx context.Context, shareSlug string) (*StudentPracticeTaskPublication, error)
	ListPublicationsByStudentID(ctx context.Context, studentID string) ([]StudentPracticeTaskPublication, error)
	MarkPublicationReady(ctx context.Context, publicationID string, visibility int16, publishedAt *time.Time, updatedAt time.Time) error
	UpdatePublicationVisibility(ctx context.Context, publicationID string, visibility int16, publishedAt *time.Time, updatedAt time.Time) error
}

type PracticeTaskPublicationFileStorage interface {
	DownloadSourceArchive(ctx context.Context, fileID string) ([]byte, error)
	DownloadPublicationSnapshot(ctx context.Context, fileID string) ([]byte, error)
	UploadTemporaryArchive(ctx context.Context, ownerID, filename string, content []byte) (string, error)
	Activate(ctx context.Context, fileID string) error
}
